from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] != 0]
            if not colored:
                continue
            mr0, mr1 = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            mc0, mc1 = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            th, tw = mr1-mr0+1, mc1-mc0+1
            motif = [[grid[mr0+i][mc0+j] for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
            for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                    out[y][x] = motif[(y-mr0)%th][(x-mc0)%tw]
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-ea2ed5df.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
